name: Infrastructure Concept Designer
notes: Pick or write a site brief for a pathway, car park, street lighting or kerb job and get three concept options with a drawn plan sketch, rough quantities, a cost range from made-up unit rates, sample design rule checks and a side by side comparison; AI picks settings from fixed lists and template options are used when AI is off, and a short concept note can be copied or drafted in Outlook. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Turns a site brief into three concept options for paths, car parks, street lighting or kerbs, each with a plan sketch, cost range and design checks. Compare them, mark a preferred option and copy a concept note to send.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: all four sample briefs, Options A to C and Compare, mark preferred, constraint validation and update, write your own brief (validation, placeholders, bay target from text), Copy concept note with Draft in Outlook beside it, SVG and full note via a downloads stub, productionise panel and All AI prototypes button, no page or console errors, no horizontal scroll, visible focus, no em or en dashes in visible text. AI stand-in: good reply (validated, dash stripped, recommended option opened), busy error, null reply and Stop each keep the shown options with a plain message; names, address, email and phone in notes do not reach the prompt.
